integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the standard rooted-forest enumeration k*n^(n-k-1), which is stated and used with its exact boundary. Computational checks are finite and are not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random mappings only; earlier equivalent statements may exist in uninspected historical literature. The exact identity is proved analytically and checked by finite enumeration, not independently audited.
title: Origin-deletion transfer and hidden square-root anticorrelation in random mappings
